title: Eventual exactness and finite locally free kernels of an affine lift
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a quasi-compact open, F a perfect object of D(O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex], and K a bounded-above complex of finite free O_X-modules whose derived restriction represents F. Write R for restriction of module sheaves to U. There is an integer N such that, for every r at most N, R(K) is exact in every degree at most r and the kernel of R(d^r) is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. This only concerns the restricted complex; no equality of image and kernel on X is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08EG, proof of Lemma 36.13.6, finite-free lift and stupid truncation; read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EG

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-perfect-pseudo-coherent-locally-finite-tor] to F. Quasi-compactness gives a global Tor interval [a,b] by [lem-pc-quasi-compact-finite-tor-dimension]. Tensoring with the structure sheaf then gives vanishing of ordinary cohomology below a; exact restriction and the supplied representation transfer this to R(K).

Identify X with Spec of its global sections, transporting K and U along that scheme isomorphism. Apply [lem-pc-affine-finite-free-sheaf-complex-lift] to the transported K. This gives a bounded-above finite-free module complex whose associated sheaf complex is isomorphic to K. The affine tilde/sections equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] carries the termwise maps and their kernels and images compatibly.

For each r at most N=a-1, apply [lem-sc-affine-truncation-kernel-finite-locally-free] using this model and the common Tor interval. Its restricted image identifies with the outgoing kernel on U and is finite locally free. Transport this property back through the termwise and scheme-isomorphism comparisons. Ordinary cohomology vanishing gives exactness in every degree i at most r. For U empty all restricted sheaves are zero; take N=0 and use the rank-zero sheaf.

theorem affine_lift_eventual_free_kernels
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (hF : IsPerfect U.toScheme F)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hrep : Nonempty
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ F)) :
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ r : ℤ, r ≤ N →
      (∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ r → ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).ExactAt i) ∧
      (kernel (R.map (K.d r (r + 1)))).IsFiniteLocallyFree
